neighbours.label: a word that marks an object as given or provided by someone (gift, donated, supplied, lent), on the word itself just before its source is named
fire: In the hall hangs a large tapestry, a gift from the city of Ghent.
The old piano in the chapel was donated by a local family in 1950.
The library's rare atlas was donated by a sea captain's widow.
On her desk sat a brass clock, a present from her grandfather.
The new ambulance was donated by the town's rotary club.
The vase in the window was a wedding gift from her aunt.
The fossil collection was lent by the national museum for the summer.
Each classroom received laptops donated by a software company.
quiet: In the hall hangs a large tapestry that shows the city of Ghent.
The old piano in the chapel was tuned by a local man in 1950.
The library's rare atlas was found in a sea captain's trunk.
On her desk sat a brass clock that ticked loudly all day.
The new ambulance was parked behind the town's fire station.
The vase in the window was painted blue with white flowers.
The fossil collection was cleaned by the museum staff over the summer.
Each classroom received a fresh coat of paint over the holidays.
